stem.text: A thick copper wire is connected to a thin copper wire in series with a cell, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit with a cell, a thick wire and a thin wire in series. Printed labels: thick wire, thin wire.

stem.text: What is significantly **less** in the thick wire than in the thin wire?

A.text: the charge passing a point per unit time

B.text: the drift speed of the electrons

C.text: the number density of the free electrons

D.text: the number of free electrons passing a point per unit time
